rules.name: RSA Private Key
rules.description: Unencrypted RSA private cryptographic key detected in source code.
rules.remediation: Remove the private key from the codebase, revoke and rotate the corresponding keypair, and inject keys dynamically via secret vaults (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS).

rules.name: OpenSSH Private Key
rules.description: OpenSSH private key detected in plaintext.
rules.remediation: Revoke the SSH key immediately from authorized_keys files and servers. Generate a new SSH keypair and use SSH agent forwarding or key management services.

rules.name: Generic Private Key
rules.description: Cryptographic private key (DSA, EC, PGP, or generic) detected in source code.
rules.remediation: Revoke and rotate the exposed private key. Ensure secrets are stored in secure key management vaults.

rules.name: AWS Access Key ID
rules.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) Access Key ID detected.
rules.remediation: Deactivate and delete the exposed AWS access key via the AWS IAM Console immediately. Use IAM Roles or AWS Secrets Manager instead.

rules.name: AWS Secret Access Key
rules.description: AWS Secret Access Key assignment detected.
rules.remediation: Rotate the secret access key immediately. Migrate to temporary credentials via AWS STS or IAM Instance Profiles.

rules.name: GitHub Personal Access Token
rules.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (classic or fine-grained) or OAuth token detected.
rules.remediation: Revoke the token immediately from your GitHub Account Settings -> Developer settings -> Personal access tokens. Restrict permissions using fine-grained scopes.

rules.name: Google Cloud API Key
rules.description: Google Cloud Platform or Firebase API Key detected.
rules.remediation: Restrict or delete the API key in the Google Cloud Console. Apply API restrictions and HTTP/IP referrer restrictions.

rules.name: GCP Service Account Key
rules.description: Google Cloud Service Account JSON key structure detected.
rules.remediation: Delete the compromised service account key in GCP IAM & Admin Console. Migrate to Workload Identity Federation.

rules.name: OpenAI API Key
rules.remediation: Revoke the key in the OpenAI API dashboard. Use environment variables to pass API keys at runtime.

rules.name: Stripe Live API Key
rules.description: Stripe Live Secret Key or Restricted API Key detected.
rules.remediation: Roll the live Stripe API key immediately from the Stripe Dashboard under Developers -> API keys.

rules.name: Slack Token or Webhook URL
rules.description: Slack Bot/User OAuth Token or Incoming Webhook URL detected.
rules.remediation: Revoke the Slack token or delete the incoming webhook from the Slack App Management console.

rules.name: SendGrid API Key
rules.remediation: Revoke and regenerate the SendGrid API key via the Twilio SendGrid console.

rules.name: Twilio API Key / Auth Token
rules.description: Twilio Account SID or API Key detected.
rules.remediation: Verify in Twilio Console whether this identifier is an API key or Account SID and rotate if exposed.

rules.name: Database Connection URI
rules.description: Hardcoded database connection string containing plaintext username and password detected.
rules.remediation: Externalize database connection strings into secure environment variables (e.g. DATABASE_URL) or secret management systems.

rules.name: Database Password Assignment
rules.remediation: Remove the hardcoded password and inject it at runtime using environment variables.

rules.name: JSON Web Token (JWT)
rules.description: Static JSON Web Token (JWT) detected in source code.
rules.remediation: Avoid hardcoding static tokens in code. Issue tokens dynamically through authentication flows.

rules.name: Authentication Secret Key
rules.description: Authentication master secret, session token signing key, or OAuth client secret detected.
rules.remediation: Store session signing secrets in environment variables or key vaults. Rotate exposed keys immediately.

rules.name: Hardcoded Password Assignment
rules.description: Hardcoded password variable assignment detected in source code.
rules.remediation: Remove plaintext passwords from code. Load credentials securely from environment variables or a vault.

rules.name: Generic API Key / Secret Token
rules.description: Generic hardcoded API key or authorization token pattern detected.
rules.remediation: Externalize API keys and secret tokens into environment configurations or a secrets manager.
